title: MSAA 2D has no effect within a CanvasGroup node
body: - *Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/discussions/13164#discussioncomment-17898224.* ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.dev1, 4.7.1.stable, 4.8.dev 4e8c061c9 ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (4e8c061c9) - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 610.43.03) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description MSAA 2D has no effect within a CanvasGroup node: MSAA 2D = Disabled | MSAA 2D = 8× -|- | This occurs in both Forward+ and Mobile ([2D MSAA isn't implemented in Compatibility yet](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/69462)). This may be intentional for performance reasons, but it should be documented. This could also be implemented as an opt-in property to allow the use of 2D MSAA on specific CanvasGroup nodes, so you only get a performance impact when you *need* MSAA in that particular CanvasGroup. ### Steps to reproduce - Enable MSAA 2D in the Project Settings. - Add a CanvasGroup node with vector-based elements as children (Line2D, Polygon2D, rotated ColorRect, etc). - Add the same nodes outside a CanvasGroup node for comparison, and notice how only the nodes outside the CanvasGroup get antialiased by MSAA. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [test_canvas_group_msaa.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30721522/test_canvas_group_msaa.zip)
